# Test Standard Profile

Invented wording used by the test suite. The real DESS Standard lives in
app/minutes/profiles/dess_standard.md.

## Hard floors

- Do not invent facts, decisions or reasons.
- Do not hide dissent, conflicts or unresolved concerns.

## Minuting Policy

### MP1 Meeting context

Record who met, when and in what capacity. Only record attendance supported by the evidence.

### MP4 Outcomes

State each outcome precisely, with limits and conditions. Never infer approval from silence or
an agenda label.

### MP7 Actions

Record agreed actions with owners and dates only where agreed.

## Writing Style

### WS1 Voice

Formal British English, reported speech, past tense.

### WS5 Decisions

Use a clear outcome verb for each decision.

## Stages

Ask only questions whose answer would change the record.
